decisions.reason: After an initial period of patience, this cheese now shows two years without website presence, and because it was neither a flagship nor a heavily public commitment, management would likely end support and reallocate resources.

Although the multi-model spicy cheese line created more sunk costs and would normally invite persistence, its disappearance from the website for two years makes continued commitment harder to justify and portfolio simplification more likely.

The mild creamy soft cheese fit the assortment well, but with no visible follow-through by 2020 to 2021 and no special strategic centrality, management would likely conclude the launch has not earned continued backing.

This washed-rind soft cheese built on existing capabilities, yet prolonged non-observation on the website suggests weak traction, and with limited public commitment the firm would likely withdraw it within the year.
